title: Price Adjustments
description: Ordered selection-dependent fee and discount rows on a binding fixed-price option. fixed_price is the base rate, charged when the buyer selects no declared value. A row matches when the buyer's selection includes its value (full-identity match). At most one row fires per dimension — the first match in declared order. Stacking is additive against the base rate: each firing row contributes a delta computed from fixed_price (an amount row contributes its amount, a rate row contributes fixed_price x rate), fees add and discounts subtract, so 10% and 10% from two dimensions add 20% of fixed_price and cross-dimension order does not change the price. Each rate delta is rounded half away from zero to the option's price precision — the greatest of the currency minor-unit exponent, 4 for cpm/vcpm/cpc/cpcv/cpv, and the fewest decimal places that exactly represent fixed_price and each amount (by numeric value, not lexical form) — and the resolved price is the exact sum, never below zero. Omitted or default selections match no row. The resolved total is the purchase's fixed_price and each fired row is recorded in price_breakdown as its currency amount. Changing the table requires a new pricing_option_id. Sellers MUST NOT return a table to callers below adcp_version 3.3; consumers treat an unknown dimension as unpurchasable. Normative rules: docs/media-buy/advanced-topics/pricing-models.mdx#selection-dependent-price-adjustments.

format_option_ref.description: Matches when the purchase's format_option_refs includes this reference; MUST resolve to a format option of the same product.

placement_ref.description: Matches when a mode selected placement_selection includes this placement; MUST resolve to a targetable placement of the same product, which MUST declare overlay_support.placement_selection.

kind.description: fee adds its delta to the resolved price; discount subtracts it.

name.description: Name carried into the resolved price_breakdown.

rate.description: Decimal proportion of the option's fixed_price (0.15 for 15%), never of another row. Mutually exclusive with amount. A premium of 100% or more uses amount.

amount.description: Fixed amount in the option's currency per pricing unit. Mutually exclusive with rate.

verifier_constraints.selector_resolution: Each row's ref MUST resolve to a value the same product publishes; matching is full-identity equality after resolution.
verifier_constraints.resolution: One row per dimension (first match). Each firing row contributes a delta from fixed_price (amount, or fixed_price x rate rounded half away from zero to price precision); resolved price = fixed_price + sum of fee deltas - sum of discount deltas, independent of cross-dimension order; never negative (reject with INVALID_REQUEST, never clamp).
verifier_constraints.price_precision: Greatest of the currency minor-unit exponent, 4 for cpm/vcpm/cpc/cpcv/cpv, and the fewest decimal places exactly representing fixed_price and each amount, by numeric value.
verifier_constraints.resolved_price_binding: A buyer-supplied pricing that differs from the resolved result MUST be rejected with INVALID_REQUEST; the seller MUST NOT silently reprice and SHOULD return error.details.resolved_fixed_price and resolved_price_breakdown.
verifier_constraints.snapshot_rederivation: In accepted purchase pricing, base_fixed_price plus the recorded fired-row amounts equals fixed_price, and re-resolving the retained table from base_fixed_price over the purchase's selections reproduces them.
